scope: 22 named mounts added to the existing Loadout equipment catalog. No interface, state schema, or compatibility logic changes.

sources.coverage: All 22 names and per-mount facts, including unique mount variants.
Cross-check species, food, bond bonuses, and ability lists; preserves documented disagreements.
Japanese mount list checked for species, preferred food, and reported bonus/ability disagreements.

notes: Stat bonuses and growth modifiers are reported maximum-bond values, not inferred skill-rank requirements.
Empty requirements objects are intentional: the existing readiness display asks users to verify species/class access.
English names and translated aliases vary between sources. Black Magonius preserves the legacy black-feathered-maginius ID; Red Meganius preserves red-meganius.
Other mounted classes, food items, and location names are not separate mount breeds.

disagreements.wild-ornius: Dex growth is disputed (5% or 15%); the listed 15% follows the English database and GameWith.
disagreements.magonius: Spawn coverage differs between guides; Headsman's Rock is shared.
disagreements.ferghanan-horse: Growth split is disputed: some sources substitute Spd 5% for Dex 5%.
disagreements.dark-pegasus: Preferred taste is disputed (bitter or spicy); bitter follows GameWith and this database.
disagreements.falicorn: Ability listings differ between guides; the listed names follow the English database.
disagreements.red-falicorn: The second ability is only listed by the English database; confirm in-game.
disagreements.red-bau: Paired Arts-Focus values differ between sources; its exact effect is not assumed here.
disagreements.black-bau: Growth split is disputed (Spd 15% or Dex 15%); ability listings also differ between guides.
disagreements.saramis-war-elephant: Growth bonuses are disputed: GameWith reports 10% in HP, Str, Dex, Def and Res instead. Confirm in-game.
